content.text:
I've submitted index 14 (Sb fraction 0.39) as the best composition, but this line doesn't appear to have a real winner. None of the compositions I measured showed a real photoresponse.

I used all 5 EQE measurements, spread across the composition line:

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0.12 | -0.00044 |
| 9 | 0.23 | -0.00109 |
| 14 | 0.39 | -0.00004 |
| 22 | 0.67 | -0.00063 |
| 28 | 0.82 | -0.00048 |

- **Why index 14:** it gave the highest reading, but every value is essentially zero (within about ±0.001%). The ranking is just noise.
- **Why nothing responds:** this is my explanation, not something I tested. The known Mg–Sb–O phases are MgO, the Mg antimonates and MgSb₂O₆. All of them are expected to have band gaps well above the 2.4 eV light, so they shouldn't absorb it. I didn't run the band-gap model or any XRD to confirm this.
- **What's left unchecked:** 24 of the 29 compositions weren't measured, so a narrow active spot between my sample points can't be ruled out. All 5 XRD measurements went unused.
